L6·N12128unmasked layer
Mostly a diffuse/low-signal unit: its (weak positive) peaks land on ordinary function or noun tokens inside formal, mid-sentence prose ("me", "per", "of", "the", "documentation", "Contract"), while its strongest (negative) responses come at the second token of a document's opening phrase — e.g. "This **report**", "Hey **there**", "Te**aching**" — so it mainly marks document-initial header/greeting position by suppression.

L18·N5416unmasked layer
This neuron fires on determiner/head positions of indefinite or newly-introduced noun phrases ("a", "an", "two", "of", capitalized new noun) and is strongly suppressed at definite-reference determiners ("the", "This", "These"), so it appears to track indefinite vs. definite NP marking.
